summary: Tested Atlas conversation rename (PATCH) and delete (DELETE). Backend endpoints all pass (10/10). Frontend has a CRITICAL bug in the main sidebar (_layout.tsx): clicking Rename/Delete in the three-dot dropdown does NOT trigger the rename/delete action - instead it navigates to a different (adjacent) conversation because the absolutely-positioned dropdown overlaps neighbouring rows and click events bleed through due to broken z-index stacking context.

ui_bugs.issue: The dropdown is absolutely positioned (top:34, right:0, zIndex:100) inside convItemWrap. Its parent has position:relative but no zIndex, so it creates a stacking context that does NOT elevate above sibling conversation rows. When user clicks 'Rename' or 'Delete', the click lands on the underlying next-row's TouchableOpacity (convItem) and fires handleSelectConv instead. Verified: clicking conv-rename-<new_id> triggers a GET /api/atlas/conversations/<other_id> and the app selects a different conversation. No PATCH/DELETE request is sent. Rename input never appears; conversation is never deleted.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking Rename in dropdown does not open the rename input (rename-input never appears). Instead, adjacent conversation is selected.
Clicking Delete in dropdown does not send DELETE /api/atlas/conversations/{id}; no network request is fired for delete, and the conversation remains (verified 200 on GET after 'delete' click).

issues: convDropdown z-index does not effectively elevate above sibling conversation rows (RN web stacking-context issue). Also the three-dot menu button click, while opening the dropdown correctly, sometimes coincides with a row activation on RN web depending on layout.

action_items: Fix z-index stacking on _layout.tsx sidebar dropdown. Recommended fix: when convMenu === conv.id, apply zIndex to the convItemWrap style (e.g. style={[st.convItemWrap, convMenu===conv.id && {zIndex: 200}]}) so the absolutely positioned dropdown elevates above sibling rows. Additionally consider position:'relative' + isolation or portal rendering. Repro: 1) login as super admin, 2) open sidebar, 3) click ... on any conversation, 4) click Rename -> no input appears; the next row's conversation opens instead. Same for Delete.

learn.tsx internal conversation list pencil/trash icons are missing data-testid attributes on the TouchableOpacity wrappers, making automated UI testing unreliable (pencil-outline and trash-outline). Add testIDs like conv-inline-rename-<id> and conv-inline-delete-<id>.

Consider preventing the parent row TouchableOpacity from firing when a click originated from the menu/dropdown children (e.g. wrap dropdown in Pressable with onPress={e => e.stopPropagation()} on RN web, or restructure so dropdown is a sibling of the row list rather than child).
critical_code_review_comments: atlas_v3.py rename endpoint validates via manual length check after HTTPException; consider using Pydantic Field(min_length=1, max_length=200) for cleaner validation (currently missing title returns 422 while empty returns 400 — mildly inconsistent but acceptable).
Sidebar dropdown pattern is duplicated between _layout.tsx and learn.tsx (rename/delete logic). Extract to a shared hook/component to avoid drift.
Frontend rename/delete calls in _layout.tsx do not check response.ok — a failing PATCH/DELETE silently updates local state, giving a false success indication.

rca_of_the_issue: React Native Web renders TouchableOpacity as clickable divs. The dropdown View has position:absolute with zIndex:100, but its parent (convItemWrap) has position:relative with no zIndex. Sibling convItemWraps (also position:relative, no zIndex) create the SAME stacking context, so the dropdown does not stack above later siblings. When the dropdown visually overlays the next conversation row, browser hit-testing routes the click to the later-rendered sibling row's TouchableOpacity (handleSelectConv) instead of the dropdown item — hence the neighbouring conversation is opened and startRename/deleteConv are never called. FIX: set zIndex on the convItemWrap when its dropdown is open (e.g. zIndex: convMenu===conv.id?200:1) OR raise the dropdown out of the row via portal/parent list.
